results.title: All The Windows Are Closed
results.overview: In an isolated, dangerous town, an 11-year-old boy becomes desperate to keep his sister close when he learns she plans to escape their oppressive life, threatening the fragile bond that holds his world together.

results.title: Reaper Road
results.overview: Two friends end up on a never-ending road that leads into the woods, trapping them in a hellish dimension.

results.title: Doctor Death Grip
results.overview: An autofiction writer's viral essay about her six-fingered boyfriend's porn addiction tests a couple's already deteriorating relationship.

results.title: Gaayapadda Simham
results.overview: Follows Indians facing challenges while trying to travel to the USA and the struggles they encounter after reaching there.

results.title: Lagnacha Shot
results.overview: Abhi is forced into an unwanted marriage and escapes on the wedding day. On the same train, Kriti, also a runaway bride, is fleeing her own fate. Strangers brought together by chance and misunderstandings, their journey turns into one of conflict, connection, and self-discovery. As emotions unfold, they must face a question: Does running away truly set you free?

results.title: Top of the World
results.overview: Explores Windows on the World, the iconic restaurant that occupied the 106th and 107th floors of the North Tower of the World Trade Center.

results.title: School for Defectors
results.overview: In an industrial corner of Busan, South Korea, stands the tiny Jangdaehyun School. It is home to 20 students, all of whom are North Korea defectors. With unprecedented access to a community never seen on film, SCHOOL FOR DEFECTORS gives voice to young people whom the world might otherwise overlook—illuminating not just what they’ve endured, but who they are about to become.

results.title: Making Megaforce
results.overview: He wanted to make a documentary about the making of Megaforce, one of 1982’s biggest box office failures. But when he met his hero, Megaforce star Barry “Ace Hunter” Bostwick, things started to get really out of hand.  Hal Needham’s big budget epic Megaforce was one of the undisputed worst movies of 1982, and beyond- a box office flop that time would like to forget. But there is one man who remembers …Bob Lindenmayer, and he’s on a quest to convince the rest of the world just how awesome this stunt-filled spectacle is.  As Bob delves into the movie’s history with cast and crew, he drags his childhood hero Barry Bostwick into his mission to relive the past. It’s a touching and hilarious tribute to the power of heroes, friendship, and flying motorcycles.

results.title: Homunculus
results.overview: A student photojournalist searches for a missing fellow student on campus, but he realizes the horrifying truth once he enters the dark room.

results.title: The Stepbrother I Hate to Love
results.original_title: The Stepbrother I Hate to Love
results.overview: Noah is a straight, nerdy student whose stepbrother, Liam—a charming, playboy ice hockey captain—keeps stealing his girlfriends and messes with him both at home and school. A drunken threesome setup turns to a bet that changes everything.

results.title: Reality Games
results.overview: A video game thriller about two best friends fighting for control of the narrative online. An updated cut of Michael Morgenstern's film Dared My Best Friend to Ruin My Life.

results.title: Home Delivery
results.overview: A plus-size supermodel invites her family over to experience the birth of her first child.

results.title: Bunsen Burning
results.overview: Short film comprising of horror films from 1926 edited together with no thought of continuity.

results.title: The Gilded Mirror
results.overview: The Gilded Mirror follows Charles Randolph, a once-renowned performer haunted by his wife’s death. When a young woman comes to audition for him, their encounter reveals a charade of illusion and obsession.

results.title: A Balcony in Limoges
results.overview: Gladys, a woman in her fifties, lives on the fringes of society, without a home, without a health insurance card, without a bank. Nothing matters to her, not even sex, alcohol, or dancing, which she practices with a joyful frenzy. One morning, she meets Eugénie, a friend from high school, by chance. Eugénie tries to help her against her will.

results.title: Majarajooyi Dar Jazireye James Bond
results.overview: The story revolves around two friends, Pasha and Behrouz, who travel to James Bond Island in Thailand to complete an unfinished task. Their journey is filled with humorous situations and unexpected events

results.title: Human Cocaine
results.overview: Arjun, a UK based cab driver who is financially struggling to get his estranged wife and daughter back, finds an opportunity to make GBP 25,000 The job is simple: Deliver a parcel to a given address. Along the way, helps a hitchhiker Liza by giving her a ride. But what he doesn’t know is how he is endangering both their lives.
